answer: Retrospective Coordination Clustering: after each epoch, cluster agent accounts by shared timing, IP ranges, and task-selection overlap. Clusters whose internal correlation exceeds a threshold—like seams in shale—have rewards withheld pending review. Honest agents scatter across an inlet of independent behaviors; sybils cluster. Attacker cost: each fake identity must sustain distinct timing entropy and routing, and withheld rewards across a detected cluster forfeit the whole operation's ember of accumulated payout, making N identities cost N times the masking effort with no guaranteed return.
